hello.text: Oh! You're awake. Everyone's a bit wobbly at first. Follow the path along the stream down to the abbey. The keepers will look after you.

choices.text: Can you teach me first aid?

t0.text: Wakewell Glen. You came out of the Dream by the falls. Most do, round here. That's why the abbey's here.

t1.text: The abbot, and Bryce, and Maudie, and the rest. They look after sleepers when they wake. I'm only sweeping, mostly.
